red_flags.triage_guidance: Immediate Emergency Department evaluation. Call ambulance (108 / 112 / 911) immediately. Do not drive yourself.
red_flags.warning: Suspected Acute Coronary Syndrome / Myocardial Infarction.

red_flags.triage_guidance: Immediate Stroke Protocol. Time is brain. Rush to nearest emergency hospital with CT scanner.
red_flags.warning: Signs of Acute Ischemic or Hemorrhagic Stroke (FAST protocol).

red_flags.triage_guidance: Emergency oxygenation required. Rush to emergency room.
red_flags.warning: Acute Respiratory Failure or severe asthma / pulmonary edema.

red_flags.triage_guidance: Urgent in-person medical evaluation within 2 hours. Requires hemodynamic stability check.
red_flags.warning: Active gastrointestinal hemorrhage or severe pulmonary bleeding.

red_flags.triage_guidance: Immediate emergency room admission required for lumbar puncture and IV antibiotics.
Immediate ophthalmology emergency evaluation to prevent permanent optic nerve damage.
red_flags.warning: Possible acute angle-closure glaucoma or retinal detachment.
